item.title: Club Shop &amp; Ticket Office Closure Notice - Fleetwood Town Football Club
item.description: The Highbury Stadium Club Shop and Ticket Office will be closed on Monday 31 March for a stock take ahead of a summer of change across the Club’s retail and ticketing operations. The closure will apply across all Club retail and ticketing operations, including Highbury Stadium, Poolfoot Farm (retail only) and the Club’s Online Store.
